product_one_liner.value: Fluxco helps utilities, data centers, renewable-energy developers, EPCs and industrial buyers specify transformers, obtain competitive bids from global manufacturers, and manage procurement through delivery and support.
product_one_liner.notes: The official site and job description describe specification-to-bid procurement, manufacturer matching, delivery, service and warranty. The company overview identifies utilities, data centers, EPCs, industrial developers and renewable-energy buyers. Sources: https://fluxco.com/, https://fluxco.com/careers/enterprise-account-executive-energy-infrastructure and https://www.teardown.ai/companies/fluxco.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing-page link appears in the homepage navigation or footer, the pricing URL returned no page, and the FAQ directs buyers to request a quote. An illustrative transformer estimate is not a public pricing-plan page. Sources: https://fluxco.com/ and https://fluxco.com/faq.

named_customers.notes: The closest case-study material names only Antora Energy and describes its procurement results; no second customer name was found. Under the requested fewer-than-two rule, the result is an empty list rather than a one-name list. Investors Congruent Ventures and 8VC were excluded. Source: https://product.ferryman.app/en/articles/2026-07-26-fluxco-transformer-procurement.

employee_band.notes: The matching company profile reports 13 employees, which falls within 11-20. Headcount is time-sensitive and comes from a third-party profile. Source: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: Fluxco's own privacy policy explicitly says the company is based in Austin, Texas. Source: https://fluxco.com/privacy. | hq_country: Fluxco's privacy policy says it is based in Austin, Texas, and its matching company profile explicitly identifies the United States. Sources: https://fluxco.com/privacy and https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about.

founded_year.notes: The company profile matching fluxco.com explicitly gives 2025 as its founding year. Source: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about. This is a third-party company record.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index contains transformer buyer guides, equipment specifications and industry commentary, not two engineer-authored posts about building Fluxco's software or infrastructure. The technical equipment articles do not meet the requested engineering-blog definition. Source: https://fluxco.com/resources.

public_docs.notes: The homepage links to buyer tools and a single transformer FAQ, but no public product-documentation site, help center or developer portal. The resource articles are transformer guides rather than product documentation. Sources: https://fluxco.com/ and https://fluxco.com/faq.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A live posting is titled Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist). It qualifies under the specified rule that an engineering role with AI in its title counts, although it is not an ML-research position. Source: https://fluxco.com/careers/ai-native-full-stack-engineer.

model_provider.notes: No product model or provider was identified after reviewing the homepage, FAQ, resources and legal disclosures. The privacy policy mentions AI service providers without naming them. Claude Code, Cursor and Codex are named as developer coding tools, not as models powering the product, so they are excluded. Sources: https://fluxco.com/privacy, https://fluxco.com/terms and https://fluxco.com/careers/ai-native-full-stack-engineer.

compliance_certs.notes: The complete privacy policy was reviewed and names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS. Its security section describes general safeguards rather than certifications. The empty list means no qualifying claim was found on the reviewed legal page, not that Fluxco lacks such certifications. Source: https://fluxco.com/privacy.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both funding records identify the latest round as Seed. Sources: https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026 and https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about. | funding_date: The round record and company profile identify July 27, 2026 as the latest funding date, normalized to 2026-07. Sources: https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026 and https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5903dd7be4b0a9f300ed30a3/fluxco#a:about. | funding_amount_usd: The funding-round record explicitly lists $26,000,000, consistent with the approximately $26 million seed investment reported by the Wall Street Journal. Sources: https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026 and https://www.wsj.com/pro/venture-capital/fluxco-raises-26-million-for-ai-platform-to-find-the-right-transformer-d2b363fd.

raised_18mo.notes: The documented $26 million round dated July 27, 2026 falls within the preceding 18 months. Source: https://www.gaebler.com/VC-Funding-DE10A853-15ED-440C-8C0D-F10CE3B3E6A8-Fluxco-07-27-2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Account Executive (Data Centers) posting is also listed on Fluxco's careers page. Sources: https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers and https://fluxco.com/careers.

launched_6mo.notes: A dated company analysis reports an August 2026 launch of the Global Transformer Network, including full EPC service and compliance verification, within the six-month window. This relies on a secondary report; the specific primary launch post could not be located in the readable company feed. Source: https://www.teardown.ai/companies/fluxco.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman's dated profile records his Founder and CEO role at Fluxco as starting in January 2026, inside the 12-month window. Source: https://linkedin.com/in/briantochman.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable account-executive posting refers to 'the CRM' without naming a vendor and lists outbound channels rather than a named sales or marketing platform. No qualifying system was named in the other reviewed job material. Source: https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers.
